title: A trade-off between fungal biofilm formation and persistence in the host
content:
by Shannon Esher Righi

Fungal biofilm formation has long been considered an important virulence trait. A new study on Candida parapsilosis outbreak isolates in PLOS Biology challenges this, finding that low biofilm-producing strains are better adapted for immune evasion and survival.
